description:
FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) is AMD’s alternative to upscaler tech like Nvidia DLSS, and it’s pretty good. But the latest frame generation goodies in FSR 4 are only available to the latest Radeon 9000-series cards on the RDNA 4 architecture, a move that has rankled gamers using older but still powerful Radeon 7000 and 6000 cards. Today, AMD is officially changing its tune… but it’ll still be a bit of a wait.

title: AMD is bringing FSR 4 to older Radeon cards, but you’ll have to wait

description:
When AmazonBasics launched back in 2009, batteries were among the initial line-up of products—and they’re still one of the best, most classic impulse buys of this white-label brand.
